targets.title: Discounted first arrival of a planar random walk · step 1
targets.statement:
∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
    ∀ {Ω : Type} [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)]
      {X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ}, IsSimpleRandomWalkSteps X →
      ∀ (n d : ℕ), 4 ≤ d → d ≤ n → ∀ a : ℤ, 2 ∣ a → (d : ℤ) ≤ |a| →
        c * Real.log d / Real.log n ≤
          1 - ∑' k : ℕ, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / n) ^ (k + 1) *
            (ℙ {ω | position X (k + 1) ω = (a, 0) ∧
              ∀ j < k + 1, position X j ω ≠ (a, 0)}).toReal

targets.title: Erdős Problem 1166 — dembo peres rosen zeitouni · step 2
targets.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type} [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)]
    {X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ}, IsSimpleRandomWalkSteps X →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      (∑' k : ℕ, ℙ {ω | (maxLocalTime X (2 ^ k) ω : ℝ) /
        (Real.log ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 < 1 / π - ε}) ≠ ∞

targets.title: Erdős Problem 1164 · step 2
targets.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type} [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ},
    IsSimpleRandomWalkSteps X → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      1 - ε ≤ (ℙ {ω | Real.log (coveringRadius X n ω) ≤ C * Real.sqrt (Real.log n)}).toReal

targets.title: The Maxwell conjecture — three equal magnitudes
targets.statement:
theorem maxwell_conjecture.variants.three_equal_magnitudes (q : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (a : Fin 3 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (ha : Function.Injective a) (hq : ∀ j, q j ≠ 0)
    (hq' : ∀ i j, |q i| = |q j|)
    (hnd : ∀ x ∈ equilibria q a, HasNondegenerateHessianAt (potential q a) x) :
    (equilibria q a).encard ≤ 4

targets.title: Erdős Problem 1164 — dembo peres rosen zeitouni
targets.statement:
theorem erdos_1164.variants.dembo_peres_rosen_zeitouni {Ω : Type*} [MeasureSpace Ω]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ}
    (hX : IsSimpleRandomWalkSteps X) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦
      (ℙ {ω | Covers X ⌊Real.exp (t * Real.log n ^ 2)⌋₊ ω (openDisc n)}).toReal)
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.exp (-4 / t)))

targets.title: Erdős Problem 1164
targets.statement:
theorem erdos_1164 {Ω : Type*} [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)]
    {X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ} (hX : IsSimpleRandomWalkSteps X) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      1 - ε ≤ (ℙ {ω | c * Real.sqrt (Real.log n) ≤ Real.log (coveringRadius X n ω) ∧
        Real.log (coveringRadius X n ω) ≤ C * Real.sqrt (Real.log n)}).toReal

targets.title: Erdős Problem 1165
targets.statement:
theorem erdos_1165 {Ω : Type*} [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)]
    {X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ} (hX : IsSimpleRandomWalkSteps X) (r : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    ℙ {ω | ∃ᶠ n in atTop, (favouriteSites X n ω).encard = (r : ℕ∞)} = erdos_1165.answer r

targets.title: Erdős Problem 1166
targets.statement:
theorem erdos_1166 {Ω : Type*} [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)]
    {X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ} (hX : IsSimpleRandomWalkSteps X) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ᵐ ω, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ((⋃ k ≤ n, favouriteSites X k ω).encard : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log n ^ C)

targets.title: The Maxwell conjecture — three charges
targets.statement:
theorem maxwell_conjecture.variants.three_charges :
    ∀ (q : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), Function.Injective a →
      (∀ j, q j ≠ 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ equilibria q a, HasNondegenerateHessianAt (potential q a) x) →
      (equilibria q a).encard ≤ 4
